newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy wishes Yeltsin speedy recovery.
newsitem.headline: Italy wishes Yeltsin speedy recovery.

text.p: Italy's President Oscar Luigi Scalfaro sent a message on Wednesday to Russian President Boris Yeltsin, wishing him well after his heart bypass operation.

"I sincerely hope you enjoy a swift recovery so that you may continue your invaluable work toward consolidating democracy in your country and peace in the world," Scalfaro said in a statement released by his office.
Yeltsin underwent a quintuple heart bypass on Tuesday. Surgeons said the operation was a complete success and the 65-year-old patient could expect a routine convalescence.
